Annagh United Football Club, referred to as Annagh United, is a semi-professional, Northern Irish football club playing in the NIFL Championship. The club, founded in 1963, hails from Portadown and plays its home matches at the BMG Arena. The club's home colours are all red at home and all white away. Annagh United are a part of the Mid-Ulster Football Association. The club plays in the Irish Cup.
